sql: CREATE INDEX account_entry_tags_tag_id ON account_entry_tags(tag_id)
CREATE INDEX commitment_tags_tag_id ON commitment_tags(tag_id)
CREATE INDEX tags_normalized_label ON tags(normalized_label)

CREATE TABLE "account_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES financial_accounts (id), "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "minor_units" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reference_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "source" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "transfer_group_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
CREATE TABLE "account_entry_tags" ("account_entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES account_entries (id), "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), PRIMARY KEY ("account_entry_id", "tag_id"))

CREATE TABLE "actuals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurrence_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES occurrences (id), "outcome" INTEGER NOT NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "commitment_cycles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "commitment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commitments (id), "cycle_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "planned_end_date" INTEGER NULL, "actual_end_date" INTEGER NULL, "target_units" INTEGER NULL, "consumed_units" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completion_rule" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
CREATE TABLE "commitment_tags" ("commitment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commitments (id), "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), PRIMARY KEY ("commitment_id", "tag_id"))

CREATE TABLE "commitments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "description" TEXT NULL, "tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "attachment_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "entitlement_ledger_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES entitlement_plans (id), "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "units" INTEGER NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reference_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "entitlement_plans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cycle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commitment_cycles (id), "total_units" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "valid_from" INTEGER NOT NULL, "planned_expiry" INTEGER NULL, "auto_extend" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("auto_extend" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
CREATE TABLE "evidences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "actual_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES actuals (id), "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
CREATE TABLE "financial_accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, bank_code TEXT, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "financial_expectations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurrence_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES occurrences (id), "direction" INTEGER NOT NULL, "minor_units" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES financial_accounts (id), "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("occurrence_id"))

CREATE TABLE "inbox_suggestions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "staged_import_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES staged_imports (id), "draft_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "minor_units" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "merchant" TEXT NULL, "reference" TEXT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "match_allocations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "match_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transaction_matches (id), "occurrence_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES occurrences (id), "minor_units" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "occurrences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cycle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commitment_cycles (id), "schedule_definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES schedule_definitions (id), "occurrence_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_semantics" INTEGER NOT NULL, "original_scheduled_value" TEXT NOT NULL, "current_scheduled_value" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_manual_override" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_manual_override" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("schedule_definition_id", "occurrence_key"))

CREATE TABLE "reminder_instances" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reminder_rules (id), "occurrence_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES occurrences (id), "scheduled_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, "snoozed_until" INTEGER NULL, "platform_notification_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("rule_id", "occurrence_id", "scheduled_at"))

CREATE TABLE "reminder_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurrence_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES occurrences (id), "anchor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "absolute_at" INTEGER NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "body" TEXT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "replacement_occurrences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_occurrence_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_replacement_id" TEXT NULL, "scheduled_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "schedule_definitions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cycle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commitment_cycles (id), "mode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "time_semantics" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_time" TEXT NULL, "time_zone_id" TEXT NULL, "fixed_instant" INTEGER NULL, "recurrence_rule" TEXT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "occurrence_count" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "generation_horizon_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
CREATE TABLE "schema_metadata" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"))

CREATE TABLE "session_policies" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cycle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commitment_cycles (id), "provider_cancellation_consumes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("provider_cancellation_consumes" IN (0, 1)), "user_cancellation_notice_hours" INTEGER NOT NULL, "late_cancellation_consumes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("late_cancellation_consumes" IN (0, 1)), "no_show_consumes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("no_show_consumes" IN (0, 1)), "free_absence_quota" INTEGER NOT NULL, "holiday_consumes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("holiday_consumes" IN (0, 1)), "makeup_required" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("makeup_required" IN (0, 1)), "auto_extend_until_units_consumed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("auto_extend_until_units_consumed" IN (0, 1)), "max_extension_date" INTEGER NULL, "partial_unit_allowed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("partial_unit_allowed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "staged_imports" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "raw_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "retention_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "retention_until" INTEGER NULL, "last_decision_at" INTEGER NULL, "source" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "imported_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "adapter_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
CREATE TABLE "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_label" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "transaction_matches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES account_entries (id), "minor_units" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, "corrected_match_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
